questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is centered (approx. 00:08-00:10), exactly three pens are visible in a row.
The leftmost pen points downwards with a tapered tip, while the other two pens have black caps at the bottom, indicating a difference in orientation or state (uncapped vs capped).
The leftmost pen appears to be a bare refill or uncapped pen with a grey/dark tip, while the other two have distinct black caps at the bottom, creating a visual mismatch.
The leftmost pen shows a tapered writing tip at the bottom, whereas the middle and right pens have black caps covering the bottom end. This indicates a missing cap on the first pen.
The board moves steadily from left to right throughout the clip without stopping or reversing.
The pens remain fixed in their positions relative to the board as it moves.

parsed.reason: The leftmost pen is uncapped, showing a bare writing tip, while the other two pens are capped. This violates the condition that all pens must be complete and capped.

description: One pen is missing its cap while the others are capped.
